pr_title: planner: avoid have two `ExtraPhysTblID` row in same schema
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #44615

Problem Summary: When a schema has two `ExtraPhysTblID` rows, the first one will return 0 in TiKV side which caused `SelectLock` failed. And in some reasons, the `SelectLock` will ignore this problem, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/bd278a05dae96861c94cc9dc69203c26b77fe15b/executor/executor.go#L1281-L1288
So we should avoid it in planner part.

issue_context.title: Query result if not correct when using partition table
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
tpcc 100 warehouse and hash(10) patition using warehouse id
tpcc check query is not 0
maybe introduced by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/44360
the follow query expect result is 0 but got 12, but I found the query result is indeed 12 from current data. Maybe the data is not correct when do dml.
```
SELECT
    c_id,
    c_d_id,
    c1,
    c_ytd_payment,
    sm
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            c.c_id,
            c.c_d_id,
            c.c_balance c1,
            c_ytd_payment,
            (
                SELECT
                    sum(ol_amount)
                FROM
                    orders STRAIGHT_JOIN order_line
                WHERE
                    OL_W_ID = O_W_ID
                    AND OL_D_ID = O_D_ID
                    AND OL_O_ID = O_ID
                    AND OL_DELIVERY_D IS NOT NULL
                    AND O_W_ID = 2
                    AND O_D_ID = c.C_D_ID
                    AND O_C_ID = c.C_ID
            ) sm
        FROM
            customer c
        WHERE
            c.c_w_id = 2
    ) t1
WHERE
    c1 + c_ytd_payment <> sm;
```

review_comments:
If you make it an unbuffered channel instead, you can use it as a semaphore/sync object, and skip the need for the sleep.
```suggestion
	ch := make(chan bool)
```
Sorry for misunderstanding, you want the sleep to make sure the SelectLock starts to execute and blocks internally.
Would it be better to sync through a channel instead? Then there should be less chance of race and can potentially be faster than the sleep?
updated, the sleep here is to make sure select stmt executed
`SelectLock` will block until tk1 commit. I'm adding a sleep in the test case just to make sure the `SelectLock` is running and being blocked.
